subject.title: fix(codex): resolve dynamic tool hard timeout from timeoutSeconds when timeoutMs is absent

question: Should maintainers repair this branch's timeoutSeconds fallback with watchdog headroom, or consolidate on a sibling candidate for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/98864 that already proves that behavior?
rationale: The remaining blocker is merge-risk repair and candidate consolidation rather than product direction; automation should not choose which competing external branch becomes canonical without maintainer intent.

options.title: Repair this branch before merge
options.body: Require this PR to add shared seconds conversion/headroom in both timeout readers and post current-head runtime proof for the sessions_send-shaped timeout case.

options.title: Consolidate on a sibling PR
options.body: Choose a sibling candidate with the same two-reader fix plus runtime proof, then close this PR only after that canonical fix is merged or explicitly adopted.

options.title: Accept exact watchdog behavior
options.body: Maintain existing exact hard-timeout behavior for timeoutSeconds calls, accepting that structured sessions_send timeout results may be replaced by generic hard-timeout responses.

recommendation.title: Repair this branch before merge
recommendation.body: Require this PR to add shared seconds conversion/headroom in both timeout readers and post current-head runtime proof for the sessions_send-shaped timeout case.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision is centered on Codex app-server timeout ownership, and recent history shows this person touched both affected app-server files.
